lc_person: ʻAzriʼel Shoḥeṭ (1906–1993), historian at the University of Haifa; author of Meḥḳarim and Der Ursprung der jüdischen Aufklärung in Deutschland.
item_person: Azriel Shochat (1906–1993), historian and University of Haifa teacher, also named Azriel Shohat.

evidence.says: LC authorizes Shoḥeṭ, ʻAzriʼel and lists Shoḥaṭ, ʻAzriʼel and Schochat, Asriel as variants. Its source note for Der Ursprung der jüdischen Aufklärung in Deutschland (2000) gives 1906–1993 and identifies a founder of the University of Haifa department of Jewish history. LC links directly to Q64797080 and VIAF 42018496.

Azriel Shochat, alias Azriel Shohat, is a historian and university teacher with University of Haifa affiliation, birth year 1906 and death year 1993. Identifiers include LC n84023664 and VIAF 42018496.
The graph’s Open Library author identifier names ʻAzriʼel Shoḥeṭ, matching the LC heading.

Meḥḳarim edition OL3268900M is attributed to ʻAzriʼel Shoḥeṭ, includes author OL6985360A, and was published in 1982 by a University of Haifa publisher; LCCN 83190731. This matches LC’s source citation to his Meḥḳarim, copyright 1982 onward, volume 1.

notes: The name mismatch is a transliteration variation explicitly supported by LC. Although the LC heading has no dates, its source note supports Wikidata’s 1906 birth year. LC HTML was inaccessible; its official MADS/RDF JSON was read successfully.
